segments.sn46.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn46.14:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pippaliguhāyaṃ [vipphaliguhāyaṃ (sī.)] viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn46.14:1.3: Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn46.14:2.1: “Kacci te, kassapa, khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ? Kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti; paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.sn46.14:2.2: “Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ. Bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti; abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.sn46.14:3.1: “Sattime, kassapa, bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.sn46.14:3.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo kho, kassapa, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo kho, kassapa, mayā sammadakkhāto bhāvito bahulīkato abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn46.14:3.4: Ime kho, kassapa, satta bojjhaṅgā mayā sammadakkhātā bhāvitā bahulīkatā abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.sn46.14:4.2: Attamano āyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
segments.sn46.14:4.4: Tathāpahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti.

lines: 195-201. Catutthe tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosīti therassa kira imaṃ bojjhaṅgabhāvanaṃ sādhukaṃ suṇantassa etadahosi “mayhaṃ pabbajitadivasato sattame divase saccāni paṭivijjhantassa ime bojjhaṅgā pātubhūtā”ti.
Athassa “niyyānikaṃ vata satthusāsanan”ti cintayato lohitaṃ pasīdi, upādārūpaṃ visuddhaṃ ahosi, pokkharapatte patitaudakabindu viya sarīrato rogo vinivattitvā gato.
Tena vuttaṃ “tathā pahīno cāyasmato mahākassapassa so ābādho ahosī”ti.
Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi janānaṃ pabbatapāde pupphitavisarukkhavātasamphassena uppanno mandasītajaro ābādhoti veditabbo.
